verdict.rationale: Ironclad documents its own general contract-workflow tooling: a no-code contract builder, published workflows that can be launched in-app or via API, and signing. One hands-on user reports it handles new-contractor paperwork end to end, which is close to hiring paperwork. Nothing in the pack names offer letters, confidentiality/IP agreements or option grants specifically, so coverage of the story is thin. missing for 10: documented offer-letter templates or workflows, confidentiality/IP assignment agreement support, equity/option-grant paperwork handling, independent corroboration for hiring/equity use cases.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can run hiring and equity paperwork — offer letters, confidentiality/IP agreements, and option grants — through the platform

citations.quote: Whenever we have a new contractor, we shoot them an email (actually now we click a button) and they take care of the rest.
In Workflow Designer, publish the workflow you wish to launch if it has not been published already.
